svg.text: Built like the reference's figure: a circle head, dot eyes, a line mouth, one body shape, tube limbs, mitten hands. Ours: a three-stroke tuft and a plain slate-blue jumper.
dot eyes and eyelids carry the mood; a line mouth; nothing else
head circle + tuft (one group) · 2 eyes, 2 lids, 1 mouth
body: one shape · arms: 2 tubes + 2 mittens · legs: 2 tubes + 2 shoes
a pose = 8 joint angles; a head turn = the face slides across the circle
flat fills, one soft shade, thin dark outlines
